title: P2.10b Compose the Gate 1 resolver into a reachable product-contract consumer
description:
Named consumer row for P2.10a (task-db1a8566958f416b92105cc2c7e51591), filed to satisfy global rail clause 1: P2.10a lands the daemon-owned Gate 1 work identity, durable authority reader and resolver, and clause 1 requires the consumer edge to be either landed or named with a task id. This is that id.

SAFETY ORDERING, not paperwork: P2.10a must be DONE first. This row makes Gate 1 reachable from outside the daemon module; landing a wire verb before the durable reader and its refusal matrix exist would expose a gate whose only satisfying path is the public core minter `grantHumanAuthority`, which accepts a caller-supplied principal and caller-supplied time. That is the exact live-authority hole P2.10a exists to close.

MEASURED AT ae83f365 by architect-73c0eab1 while planning P2.10a, and STALE BY DEFAULT for whoever plans this row — re-measure all of it:
- `git grep -ln "productContract\|product-contract\|PRODUCT_CONTRACT" -- apps adapters packages | grep -v "^packages/core/"` returns EMPTY. product-contract is entirely core-only; there is no daemon, scheduler, MCP or Control Room surface to compose into yet.
- Gate 1 helpers exist in core and are root-barrel exported: `productContractGate1Authority` (returns the UNSATISFIED gate), `validateProductContractGate1`, `PRODUCT_CONTRACT_GATE_1_ID = "moe.product-contract.gate-1"`, work ref `product-contract-gate-1:[contractId,revisionId,revisionDigest]` (packages/core/src/product-contract/product-contract-acceptance-binding.ts).
- `checkHumanAuthority` is deliberately ABSENT from the root barrel and must stay absent (documented at product-contract-acceptance-binding.ts:6).

SCOPE DECISION INHERITED FROM P2.10a's PLANNING PASS (human-confirmed): P2.10a deliberately reuses the existing `approval.decide` runtime command kind and adds NO new command kind, so it carries zero generated fan-out. This row is where the wire verb question actually lands. If the chosen consumer needs a new RUNTIME_COMMAND_KIND, the planner MUST declare the measured five-file blast radius as owned paths and size accordingly: packages/contracts/src/runtime/runtime-vocabulary.ts (frozen tuple, insertion is alphabetical and ORDER is pinned), packages/contracts/src/runtime/runtime-contract.test.ts (independent hand-transcribed roster plus a LITERAL distinct-command count), packages/mcp/src/stdio/stdio-schemas.test.ts (STDIO_TOOL_ENTRIES is DERIVED by iterating the tuple, so a new kind publishes an MCP tool with no MCP-side edit), packages/control-room-client/src/generated/generated-client.ts (COMMITTED GENERATED ARTIFACT, regenerate with `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room-client generate`, never hand-edit) and packages/control-room-client/src/generated-coverage.test.ts (GENERATED_FILE_SHA256 and CONTRACT_DIGEST goldens). Those enforcing arms do NOT run under a contracts+mcp filtered test run, so a three-package plan reads green while the repo is red. That fan-out is very likely to push this row past the daemon sizing thresholds on its own, in which case SPIDR-split it rather than submitting an oversized plan.

Template to mirror, already delivered and consumed in production: apps/daemon/src/activation/admission-gate-resolver.ts composes apps/daemon/src/activation/human-approval-authority-reader.ts. Read both before designing this one.
definitionOfDone: VERIFY-OR-BLOCK, before anything else: confirm ON DISK that P2.10a's daemon Gate 1 reader and resolver are tracked and that the resolver derives its verdict from a durable record rather than from caller bytes. Measure the CODE, not the row status: grep the resolver for its store-backed read and confirm no public minter path can satisfy it. Report blocked naming the exact missing symbols if the premise fails; relaxing this before P2.10a is DONE opens the live-authority hole P2.10a exists to close.

A real production consumer composes the Gate 1 resolver: the call site is durable, reachable from outside apps/daemon/src/product-contract, and named in a task comment with its exact file and line. 'Exports the symbols' is not composition, and a test-only call site does not discharge this item.

The consumer surfaces the resolver's refusal VERBATIM with its exact stable code and refusing layer, adding no second adjudication of its own and collapsing no upstream code into a local one. An absent or unsatisfied gate still yields the stable unattested refusal, never a permissive default.

If a new RUNTIME_COMMAND_KIND is introduced, all five fan-out artifacts are declared owned paths and updated together, the generated client is regenerated rather than hand-edited, and both control-room-client goldens are rotated. `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room-client test` runs standalone and exits 0 with a nonzero count line. If no new kind is introduced, a task comment states that explicitly so a grader is not left guessing.

Focused daemon plus consumer-package tests run standalone with nonzero `Test Files` and `Tests` count lines, and assert the missing, forged-caller, agent-authored, foreign-work and transplanted refusals at the consumer seam. Removing the resolver call from the consumer reddens a named assertion; a green drill is a FINDING to report, not a pass to bank.
taskRails: Human authority is not delegable: never synthesize a principal, signer, custody, timestamp, approval, waiver or activation authority, and never satisfy Gate 1 from caller bytes.

Do not export `checkHumanAuthority` from the core root barrel. Its absence is a deliberate, documented guard (product-contract-acceptance-binding.ts:6): a consumer able to call it could call it and then decide for itself whether to honour the answer.
Re-measure P2.10a's delivered reader and resolver before planning; a structural core helper or a test fixture is never production proof.

Preserve foreign WIP and commit explicit owned pathspecs only. A committed generated artifact plus its rotated goldens are in-scope consequences of a tuple edit, not foreign WIP — confirm ownership with a HEAD census before calling any generated delta foreign.

implementationPlan.description: READ-ONLY (DoD 1); record commands + outputs in a row comment via `moe.add_comment`. SAFETY gate (not paperwork): exposing a Gate 1 verb before the durable reader exists would let the public core minter `grantHumanAuthority` (caller-supplied principal and time) be the only satisfying path. (a) P2.10a task-db1a8566 landed: `git ls-files apps/daemon/src/product-contract/product-contract-gate-1-resolver.ts apps/daemon/src/product-contract/product-contract-gate-1-reader.ts apps/daemon/src/product-contract/product-contract-gate-1-identity.ts` prints all three; `git grep -n "product-contract-gate-1-resolver" HEAD -- apps/daemon/src/index.ts` hits (the daemon export edge); the resolver derives from a DURABLE record: `git grep -n "getCommandDecision\|getCommandReceipt\|readEvents" HEAD -- apps/daemon/src/product-contract/product-contract-gate-1-reader.ts` hits, and the resolver's exported input type carries NO `gate`, `grant`, `principal` or timestamp field (`git grep -n "gate\|grant\|principal" HEAD -- apps/daemon/src/product-contract/product-contract-gate-1-resolver.ts` shows only comments/refusal vocabulary, never an input field). (b) P2.10a-ii task-7997ba7c landed (needed to land a REAL grant for the satisfied arm): `git ls-files apps/daemon/src/product-contract/product-contract-gate-1-command.ts` prints, and `git grep -n "product_contract.approve_gate_1" HEAD -- apps/daemon/src/daemon-command-registry.ts apps/daemon/src/daemon-command-vocabulary.ts` hits. If any is absent → `moe.report_blocked` naming the row and the missing symbol. (c) RE-MEASURE THE PATTERN this row mirrors, at HEAD: apps/daemon/src/http/goal-catalog-read.ts (port `createGoalCatalogReadPort` + handler `handleGoalCatalogReadRequest` :161-190: `authenticateHttpRequest`, `CAPABILITIES.GOAL` check, port-undefined → `LISTENER_*_UNAVAILABLE`, project mismatch, `decodeBoundedJsonBytes` exact body, REPLY/LISTENER_REFUSAL dispatch), http-listener.ts (option :133, `serveGoalCatalog` :464-481, method guard and dispatch :757-777), daemon-store-dependencies.ts (import :38, port factory :270-271, registry :324, `fromEnv` accessor :369-371), daemon-entry.ts:253 threading, and whether daemon-store-dependencies.test.ts / daemon-entry tests enumerate the port set (if they do, they are owned consequences — declare them). Confirm no daemon file names `product-contract` outside apps/daemon/src/product-contract (duplicate check). Record the resolver's exact input/result types and refusal codes AS LANDED.

NEW apps/daemon/src/http/http-listener-product-contract-gate-1.test.ts, built on http-listener-goal-catalog.test.ts's harness (`openStore` :45, `authentication` :140 with GOAL / no-capability / foreign-project principals, `start` :167, `send` :187) and driving the REAL listener over a real SqliteEventStore. Fixtures are landed through PRODUCTION: a valid `ProductContractRevision` built with core's `createProductContractRevision`/codec (root-exported, packages/core/src/index.ts:129-134); a real Gate 1 grant landed by dispatching `product_contract.approve_gate_1` through the registry seam with a minted HUMAN session (mirror product-contract-gate-1-command.test.ts from task-7997ba7c). Arms, each `toStrictEqual` on the body and pinning code AND layer: (1) SATISFIED — after the lawful grant, `POST /product-contract/gate-1/read` with body exactly `{ revision }` answers `{ outcome: "GATE", gate: <the resolver's ok record verbatim> }`; (2) MISSING — no grant → the resolver's unattested refusal forwarded VERBATIM (read the code/layer off the resolver's own suite: `PRODUCT_CONTRACT_GATE_1_REQUIRED` at `GATE_1` or `APPROVAL_HUMAN_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED` at `HUMAN_AUTHORITY_GATE` — pin whichever it emits, never both); (3) FORGED-CALLER — bodies carrying `gate`, `grant`, `principalId`, `grantedAt` or `workRef` beside `revision` refuse at the LISTENER request-shape fence (`LISTENER_PRODUCT_CONTRACT_GATE_1_REQUEST_INVALID`) BEFORE any resolver call, generated over a frozen roster `FORGED_KEYS` with `toHaveLength(5)`; (4) AGENT-AUTHORED, (5) FOREIGN-WORK, (6) TRANSPLANTED — durable records mutated exactly as the resolver suite does (product-contract-gate-1.test.ts from db1a8566 owns the recipes; import its helpers if exported, else replicate the store mutation, never the adjudication) → the resolver's codes/layers surface through HTTP unchanged; (7) REVISION MALFORMED — a revision failing core `admitProductContractRevision` → core's `ProductContractRefusal` code/layer forwarded verbatim; (8) capability (no GOAL → `PRODUCT_CONTRACT_GATE_1_READ_CAPABILITY_DENIED` at the route's private layer), foreign project (`..._PROJECT_MISMATCH`), GET → method refusal, port absent → `LISTENER_PRODUCT_CONTRACT_GATE_1_UNAVAILABLE`. A frozen roster `FORWARDED_REFUSALS` of the five resolver-forwarded codes with `toHaveLength(5)` (standing requirement 1). Whole file RED (module missing). Quote red lines.

NEW apps/daemon/src/http/product-contract-gate-1-read.ts (≤ 250) + one-line `.js` bridge. Mirror goal-catalog-read.ts exactly in shape: `PRODUCT_CONTRACT_GATE_1_READ_PATH = "/product-contract/gate-1/read"`; a MODULE-PRIVATE layer `const LAYER = "PRODUCT_CONTRACT_GATE_1_READ"` (type export only — an exported `*_LAYER` becomes a rostered security boundary owing arms); a closed roster of ROUTE-LOCAL codes only: `PRODUCT_CONTRACT_GATE_1_READ_CAPABILITY_DENIED`, `_PROJECT_MISMATCH`, `_UNREADABLE` (store threw). `createProductContractGate1ReadPort({ clock, projectId, store })` exposes `boundProjectId` and `readGate(revisionValue: unknown)`: admit through core `admitProductContractRevision` (packages/core/src/product-contract/product-contract-admission.ts:186) — a refusal is returned VERBATIM (core's code/layer, `outcome: "REFUSED"`), then call the P2.10a resolver with `{ revision, projectId, store, clock }` and return its result VERBATIM: ok → `{ outcome: "GATE", gate }`, refusal → `{ outcome: "REFUSED", code, layer }` with the resolver's own code and layer — NO second adjudication, NO collapsing into a local code (DoD 3). `handleProductContractGate1ReadRequest(deps, request)`: `authenticateHttpRequest` → `CAPABILITIES.GOAL` (same reach as the goal catalog: reading advisory product truth is project-scoped, not authority) → port present → project bound → body decoded with `decodeBoundedJsonBytes` and EXACT keys `["revision"]` (anything else → `LISTENER_PRODUCT_CONTRACT_GATE_1_REQUEST_INVALID`) → reply 200 with the port answer. The handler never reads a principal, time or gate from the body: the resolver input is built from server context only. No new RUNTIME_COMMAND_KIND is introduced (a read route, not a command) — state this in the completion comment (DoD 4).

The durable call site DoD 2 demands, reachable from outside apps/daemon/src/product-contract. (1) apps/daemon/src/http/http-listener.ts: option `productContractGate1?: ProductContractGate1ReadPort` beside `goalCatalog` (:133 and :472), a `serveProductContractGate1` function mirroring `serveGoalCatalog` (:464-481), the POST-only method guard and the path dispatch beside the goal-catalog lines (:757-777). (2) apps/daemon/src/daemon-store-dependencies.ts: import the factory (:38 style), add the port factory beside `goalCatalog` (:270-271: `createProductContractGate1ReadPort({ clock: <the same authority clock the registry uses — measure at :95-104 of daemon-command-registry.ts>, projectId: config.projectId, store })`), register it (:324) and expose it through `fromEnv` (:369-371). (3) apps/daemon/src/daemon-entry.ts:253 threading beside `goalCatalog`. If daemon-store-dependencies.test.ts or a daemon-entry test enumerates the port set (step 1 measured), update it in the same commit and declare it. Record the exact file:line of the composed call site in a row comment (DoD 2). Rerun step 2 → all arms green with nonzero counts.

Each leg alone, foreground, unpiped; quote exit code + count lines. L1 `pnpm exec vitest run --root apps/daemon --config package.json src/http/http-listener-product-contract-gate-1.test.ts src/http/http-listener-goal-catalog.test.ts src/daemon-store-dependencies.test.ts` (both flags required: apps/daemon/package.json holds the vitest config). L2 `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck` (quote the `$ tsc` echo). L3 `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` (path-attributed; foreign red disclosed verbatim). L4 `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room-client test` — must be untouched-green with a nonzero count line (DoD 4: no generated artifact changed; `git status --porcelain -- packages/control-room-client packages/contracts` EMPTY). L5 `pnpm exec vitest run --config tests/security/vitest.config.ts tests/security/boundary-roster.security.ts` — scan-minus-roster must NOT name product-contract-gate-1-read.ts (private layer).

REVIEW into the step note: can any body field reach the resolver input (grep the module for `request.body`/decoded keys — only `revision` may flow)? Does the route ever answer `GATE` without the resolver (no default)? Is the clock the composition root's, never `Date.now()` in the module? DRILLS (new files untracked until commit → SHA256 restore proof against a %TEMP% backup suffixed by worker id in a SEPARATE call; tracked files → `git diff --exit-code`): D1 REMOVE THE RESOLVER CALL — make `readGate` answer `GATE` from the admitted revision alone → the MISSING and AGENT-AUTHORED arms red (DoD 5 named drill). D2 COLLAPSE THE CODE — map every resolver refusal to `_UNREADABLE` → arms 2/4/5/6 red on code AND layer. D3 LOOSEN THE BODY FENCE — accept an extra `gate` key → the FORGED_KEYS arm reds (and only it: the resolver still ignores it, which is exactly why the fence is the listener's). D4 ROSTER — delete one FORWARDED_REFUSALS member → the length-5 arm reds. A GREEN drill is a FINDING. RECORD via `moe.add_comment` (≤4500 chars): step-1 gates, the composed call site file:line, RED lines, L1-L5 outputs, D1-D4 outcomes, the explicit statement that NO new RUNTIME_COMMAND_KIND was introduced and no generated artifact changed.
